message: No detected input validation: The verify_args function only checks argument constraints (ratio and target_class), not the structure, dtype, or value ranges of the actual ingested data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local directories (MNIST_DIR, CIFAR10_DIR) or via torchvision built-in loaders with no checksum, signature, or integrity verification of any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool; anomaly type '7' (impaired labels) is referenced but no detection logic is implemented.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples anywhere in the data preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained VGG13-BN weights via torchvision's `models.vgg13_bn(pretrained=pretrained)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to confirm integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: The code simulates imbalanced data anomalies but never validates or checks the actual label distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: Although there is an --adv argument and an --epsilon parameter hinting at adversarial training, no actual adversarial attack library (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness evaluation routine is visible in the provided code slice.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set being isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being reported to guard against metric manipulation in the provided code.
No detected input sanitization: No inference-path input validation is present; the code covers training/dataset loading only, with no shape, range, or schema checks on incoming inference requests.
No detected output bounds checks: The code contains no checks on model outputs (no NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation) anywhere in the visible inference data-flow path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN image-classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
